question: Should Telegram expose standalone message-tool `pin` and `unpin` actions for existing messages, and what gate/default should control them?
rationale: This is not a broken existing contract; it adds an agent-controlled persistent chat mutation that depends on bot administrator rights and operator intent.

options.title: Approve gated pin/unpin actions
options.body: Add Telegram `pin` and `unpin` message actions behind a dedicated action gate, document bot admin requirements, and require live Telegram proof before landing.

options.title: Keep delivery pin only
options.body: Keep current `--pin` send-time delivery support and do not expose standalone mutation actions for older messages.

options.title: Defer to pinned-message design
options.body: Handle write pin/unpin together with read/list pinned-message behavior in a broader Telegram pinned-state design.

recommendation.title: Approve gated pin/unpin actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram `pin` and `unpin` message actions behind a dedicated action gate, document bot admin requirements, and require live Telegram proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is primarily product/security boundary judgment, and Peter has recent Telegram runtime and policy-surface history.
